issues.summary: The only legacy TongDaXin path depends on missing proprietary tqcenter.tq; endpoint, authorization, limits, timeout/retry behavior, and canonical volume/amount units remain unverified. The real Legacy Feature route exists, but no real TDX Daily Bars Snapshot does.
Declared label_formula does not drive the actual training label.
Daily data task references a missing Qlib synchronization script.
Current Qlib conversion replaces its destination non-atomically.
Dataset Snapshot v1 exists as a new immutable authority contract, but current PostgreSQL, annual feature Parquet, and Qlib binary consumers have not migrated to it.
Official Factor Lab uses a Python-first candidate contract.
Factor Lab JSON registry can replace historical records.
Anti-overfit recent is not an isolated Frozen Test.
Official Factor Lab source under /tmp has durability risk.
Project Knowledge Center API and UI do not exist.
Git-to-Ledger parser/indexer exists; production deployment remains separate.

QM2-P0-005 implements bounded deterministic Factor Optimization v1 for declared lookback-window and factor-internal-weight parameters; predictive validation, threshold, random/Bayesian and distributed search remain separate future scope.
V7 Factor Lab combines Python-first research decisions, concrete parameters, loop control, dispatch, and result feedback without a formal ResearchDecision and Decision Validator boundary.
Ledger schema now has a dedicated ordered explicit-SQL runner with history, checksum, lock, up/down, and fresh-install integration; unrelated legacy schema paths remain outside this resolution.
Shared async contexts auto-commit while many services also commit internally, leaving transaction ownership inconsistent for atomic Ledger indexing.
Credential-bearing database defaults exist and shared async engine initialization may log the complete database URL.
A disposable opt-in PostgreSQL integration test exists and passes locally; CI PostgreSQL capability and scheduling remain unconfirmed.
Context schema v1 cannot encode fine-grained task IDs such as QM2-P0-002A2a2, so machine-readable next-task lists use parent QM2-P0-002.
Manifest v2 represents all current Ledger Domain families; historical v1 remains immutable with original evidence gaps.

The in-memory test double remains non-durable, while the async PostgreSQL Repository now has isolated PostgreSQL 15 transaction, rollback, savepoint, constraint, and cross-Session concurrency evidence.
Ledger migration, Repository/UoW, Manifest/Git indexing and CLI exist; production deployment and API/UI remain separate open scope.
Real PostgreSQL 15 Repository behavior passed with SQLAlchemy 2.0.51 and asyncpg 0.31.0; pinned SQLAlchemy 2.0.25 and asyncpg 0.29.0 runtime parity remains outstanding.
ADR-0010 and the Indexer require explicit trusted logical-ID to worktree binding; Manifest v1 absolute path remains informational.
Manifest v2 records repository_path or uri and validates it before constructing the unchanged Domain artifact.
Manifest v1 cannot construct complete Ledger Domain Bundles without inventing Task and child semantics; zero of seventeen historical v1 Runs are indexable, while v2 resolves future production.
QM2-P0-001F declares a result commit that differs from its containing commit.
The adjacent 2025 feature sidecar describes older bytes; exact Parquet bytes, not the stale sidecar, are authoritative for Legacy source identity.
Existing LightGBM training and Qlib still consume their legacy feature/Qlib views rather than the real immutable Legacy Dataset Snapshot.
Manifest v2 self-reference is rejected for new Runs; committed v2 self-reference is narrowly warned and excluded from ChangedFile mapping without weakening other Git evidence.
The 003LF post-commit PostgreSQL test used nonexistent AnalyzedRun.git_consistency; QM2-P0-003LF1 uses evidence.consistent and evidence.warnings, and all four opt-in tests pass.

The current official Factor Lab source directory references FactorSpec, CandidateManifest, admission, evaluator and sandbox modules whose source files are absent from that bounded directory; only its surviving contracts and runbook evidence were reusable in QM2-P0-004.

QM2-P0-008 historical external failures remain immutable; QM2-P0-008F identified invalid_json_schema, added semantic Provider-schema normalization and safe classified diagnostics, and completed one admitted external Codex Campaign without changing ResearchDecision or Campaign controls.
Baseline and External Campaigns produced sibling Registry snapshots; QM2-P0-008G reconciled them into one immutable multi-parent canonical Snapshot without rewriting either branch.
The 2026 source ends before the 2026-07-17 Candidate Lock; Fresh Validation is awaiting its first strictly post-lock date and no real result exists.
QM2-P0-010 implements the persistent content-addressed Store and migrates the complete current reachable research graph; QM2-P0-011 completes the Store-backed runtime cutover and recovery drill.
QM2-P0-009 omitted 23 of 35 Git-proven business ChangedFiles. The original Run remains inconsistent; QM2-P0-009F adds complete immutable correction evidence and a corrects relationship.
Artifact Store and Runtime v1 are single-host local-filesystem only; NFS, cloud object storage, distributed locking/cache and deletion GC are unsupported.

QM2-P0-010 omitted only its own Manifest from both integrity Git inventories. The original Run remains immutable, inconsistent and non-indexable; QM2-P0-010F records the exact 42 changed and 28 added path evidence plus a corrects relationship without changing Store behavior or artifacts.
